note: Three hand-authored personas for the Encounter Satisfaction Score (ESS) grader. calculateSatisfaction(state) returns compositeScore = mean of every answered 1-5 Likert item rounded to 2 dp (0 when nothing answered), category via satisfactionCategory (>=4.5 Excellent, >=3.5 Good, >=2.5 Fair, >=1.5 Poor, else Very Poor; 'No responses' if none), domainScores (one entry per domain that has at least one answer, in question order, mean to 2 dp) and answeredCount; unanswered (null) items are skipped, not scored as zero. Flags are SPLIT: form-app.js calls detectAdditionalFlags(state, grading.compositeScore), mirrored by flagsArgs ["state","result.compositeScore"]. Quirks verified: (1) a communication item rated 1 raises the generic FLAG-VDIS-<field> (high) not FLAG-COMM; a communication item rated exactly 2 raises FLAG-COMM-<field> (high) and is EXCLUDED from the medium FLAG-DIS list; (2) FLAG-POOR-OVERALL tests compositeScore <= 2.4 while the Poor category runs to 2.49, and FLAG-FIRST-VISIT-FAIR tests <= 3.4 while Fair runs to 3.49 - so a 2-dp composite of 2.41-2.49 or 3.41-3.49 gets the category but not the flag (the 'partial first visit' persona pins 3.47 -> Fair with no low flag); (3) flags are stable-sorted high > medium > low, so within a band insertion order (VDIS items in SECTIONS order, then COMM, then DIS, then POOR/FIRST-VISIT) is preserved. Regenerate expected with: bin/test-personas encounter-satisfaction --update

personas.name: Excellent - routine follow-up, all 19 answered
personas.description: Returning patient at a rheumatology follow-up, every item 4 or 5. Sum 92 over 19 items -> compositeScore 4.84, category 'Excellent', answeredCount 19. Domain means: Access & Scheduling 4.33 (5,4,4), Communication 5, Staff & Professionalism 5, Care Quality 5, Environment 4.67 (5,4,5), Overall Satisfaction 5. No item rated 1 or 2, composite above every flag threshold, not a first visit -> zero flags.

overallSatisfaction.comments: Dr Adeyemi always takes time to explain my blood results. Lovely nurses.

personas.name: Fair - first-visit walk-in, partially answered, 3.47 misses the Fair flag
personas.description: First-time urgent-care walk-in who skipped the two scheduling items (no appointment), treatment-plan explanation and privacy (not applicable), leaving 15 answers summing to 52 -> compositeScore 3.47, category 'Fair', answeredCount 15. Domain means: Access & Scheduling 2 (only the waiting-room item), Communication 3.5, Staff & Professionalism 4, Care Quality 3.5, Environment 3, Overall Satisfaction 3.67. Flags: exactly one - FLAG-DIS-waitInWaitingRoom (medium, rated 2, not a communication field). FLAG-FIRST-VISIT-FAIR does NOT fire even though firstVisit is 'yes' and the category is Fair, because 3.47 > 3.4 (the flag/category threshold gap).

personas.name: Poor - failed specialist referral, complaint pending
personas.description: First-visit specialist referral that went badly: eight items rated 1, three communication items rated 2, five other items rated 2. Sum 33 over 19 -> compositeScore 1.74, category 'Poor', answeredCount 19. Domain means: Access 1.33, Communication 1.75, Staff 2, Care Quality 1.67, Environment 2.67, Overall 1. Flags (17): high FLAG-VDIS for easeOfScheduling, waitInWaitingRoom, explainingCondition, respectShown, treatmentPlanExplanation, overallRating, likelyToRecommend, likelyToReturn (SECTIONS order), then high FLAG-COMM for listening, answeringQuestions, timeSpent; then medium FLAG-DIS for waitForAppointment, nursingCourtesy, involvementInDecisions, confidenceInCare, privacy (communication 2s excluded), then FLAG-POOR-OVERALL ('1.7/5.0'). No low flag: firstVisit is 'yes' but the composite is far below the 2.5 Fair floor.

visitInformation.reasonForVisit: GP referral for iron-deficiency anaemia and altered bowel habit

overallSatisfaction.comments: Appointment cancelled twice, then a 90-minute wait for a seven-minute consultation. The doctor talked over me and I left without understanding what happens next. I have contacted PALS.
